answer: Admission queue: only 20 new keys per epoch enter, ranked by a lottery weighted by an ivory-tier bond of 50 points held 10 epochs. Fakes queue behind each other, so N fakes need about N/20 epochs and N times 50 locked points, linear cost with a slow clock. Old shale-grade veterans keep a haven lane. Weakness: patient rich attackers just wait, and honest newcomers face delay.
